about_the_game: Dive deeper into the captivating world of the Wreckage with this exclusive 70-page Artbook in PDF format. Explore the intricately designed landscapes, from the hauntingly beautiful hydroponics gardens to the eerie remains of abandoned laboratories and derelict entertainment centers. The Artbook offers an in-depth look at the diverse cultures and civilizations that have shaped this colossal labyrinth of destroyed ships and space stations. Each page presents concept art, sketches, and detailed illustrations that bring to life the mysterious corridors, hangars, and factories of the Wreckage. Discover the intricate architecture and varied environments that make up this tangled, self-repairing world, and gain a new appreciation for the rich history and beauty of this dangerous and enigmatic setting. Perfect for fans who want to explore the Wreckage in a more intimate, visual way.
